useWhen: Inspect CID and storage readback receipts for agent artifacts; use when checking content identity and publication evidence.
avoidWhen: Publishing shared content without caller approval or inferring durable availability from one readback

inputs.purpose: local identity, retrieval or explicitly authorized publication

outputs.receipt: CID match, readback result, observation time and availability limits

authority.binding: caller authorization and owner-reviewed target repository policy

validation.runtime: public web-plane source contract inspected; target storage not tested

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; wildcard versions do not establish installation or runtime qualification. Bind source dependencies and effective permissions in the owning repository.
